QuerySandboxes.limit: Maximum number of sandboxes returned per page. Valid range: 1–100. Default: 100.
QuerySandboxes.nextToken: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit or pass an empty string on the first request; an empty value in the response indicates no more data.
QuerySandboxes.sandboxIds: Filter by sandbox instance IDs. Up to 100 IDs. Multiple IDs are evaluated with OR logic.
QuerySandboxes.imagePaths: Filter by actual image paths. Up to 100 paths. Multiple paths are evaluated with OR logic.
QuerySandboxes.metadata: Filter by sandbox metadata key-value pairs. All specified key-value conditions must match.
QuerySandboxes.state: Filter by sandbox state. Valid values: running, paused, killing, killed. Multiple states are evaluated with OR logic.
